title: How to Update Website's Phone Number
text:
## How to Update Website's Phone Number
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000048777
To update the website's phone number that displays on the mini header section, please follow the steps below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104990228/original/BgkmVlQtwqTDjVCdWrhW5ZvmM-l4NpU3QQ.png?1644793305 | alt: ]
Go to: Settings » General Settings » General » Website Phone Number
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104990235/original/WmOVf38cIy_NhzaGgjbWG69MurJwlx-2Mw.png?1644793339 | alt: ]
